stem.text: A ball is kicked so that it has an initial velocity of $12\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ at an angle of $50^{\circ}$ to horizontal ground.
Assume that air resistance is negligible.

stem.alt: Foot and football, with an arrow labelled 12 m s-1 drawn at 50° above a dashed horizontal line.

stem.text: What is the maximum height above the ground that is reached by the ball?
